subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Which stable public WhatsApp message-tool contract should request sticker delivery: a dedicated sticker action or an explicit send option?
rationale: Both routes require changes across the plugin action contract, media pipeline, documentation, and tests; automatic WebP detection would create a competing implicit behavior and is not justified by the current evidence.

options.title: Add explicit sticker intent
options.body: Add a documented WhatsApp-specific sticker action or explicit send option, then route only that intent through Baileys’ sticker payload.

options.title: Use automatic WebP detection
options.body: Treat qualifying WebP attachments as stickers, accepting ambiguity with ordinary WebP image attachments and a larger validation burden.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Leave ordinary WebP image delivery unchanged until maintainers want to support a stable sticker contract.

recommendation.title: Add explicit sticker intent
recommendation.body: Add a documented WhatsApp-specific sticker action or explicit send option, then route only that intent through Baileys’ sticker payload.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ownership spans both the WhatsApp send path and shared media preparation where the contract must be carried consistently.
